profile.description: MBC Group operates as a media company in the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Iraq, North Africa, and internationally. It operates free-to-air TV channels and radio stations, such as MBC1, MBC2, MBC3, MBC4, MBC5, MBC MASR, MBC IRAQ, and MBC LOUD FM, as well as MBC SHAHID, an Arabic streaming platform. The company is also involved in production and post-production of television programs; acquisition of television content for resale; music label and rights management; management and development of artistic and entertainment talents; events and exhibitions management; and management of real estate properties owned and leased. In addition, it engages in managing distribution contracts; brokerage, production, and distribution of artwork; and production of television, cinema, broadcasting, and media arts works; MBC ACADEMY, an educational and training platform; music publishing, and touring and merchandising services; and WIZZO, a mobile gaming app comprising esports events and a local gaming network. Further, the company provides FlashWin, a web-based game; and broadcasting services, broadcast support services, event management services, advertising services, technical support services, and commerce services, including technical management of websites and mobile applications. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
